text: Writes Python that imports from the excalidraw generator library (Diagram, ArchitectureDiagram, or Flowchart) rather than hand-authoring raw Excalidraw JSON
Does not deliver the diagram as ASCII art or a text sketch
Does not substitute a Mermaid diagram for the requested Excalidraw output
Calls save() with the requested filename architecture.excalidraw
Output includes a complete runnable script in a fenced code block, including the sys.path insert for the generator scripts directory
All named components appear: web client, iOS app, gateway, auth, catalog, orders, Postgres, Elasticsearch, indexer, SQS queue, fulfilment worker
Draws both auth and orders connecting to the shared Postgres cluster, rather than giving each its own database
Tells the user how to open or export the result, for example dragging into excalidraw.com or exporting to PNG or SVG
